Tuin Doom RPG Heavy marine movement reference

Reference package supplied by the user:
  FriendJohn (1).pk3

The Heavy support marine's close-follow distance, lateral recoil movement,
wall sliding, step/drop handling, and teleport catch-up were adapted from
NNR_JohnMarine in NNR_ZScript/NNR_Friend.zsc. No FriendJohn sprites, sounds,
or other binary assets are included. Vertical random velocity was omitted to
keep standard Doom marine player sprites grounded.

FriendJohn credits its original mod to Neenerwiener and its updated John
Romero sprites to tuin.
